metadata.source_note: Official archived normative text, effective 1 March 2024 through 31 December 2025. Preserves the three-month/70-workday short-term employment rule separately from the current consolidation with agricultural duration extensions. All paragraphs (1), (1a), (1b), (2), (2a), and (3) retained.
metadata.title: § 8 SGB IV: Geringfügige Beschäftigung (01.03.2024–31.12.2025)
